verdict.rationale: Mem0's entity-scoped memory lets developers scope memories by user, agent, app, and session, which enables separating private per-user memories from shared/group-level ones (mem0-docs-9, mem0-docs-30), and self-hosted deployments add per-user API keys for access separation (mem0-docs-5, mem0-docs-22). However, there's no documented ACL/permissions layer for selectively sharing specific memories across agents while keeping others private within the same scope, no explicit 'team/group memory' concept, and no independent verification of this cross-agent sharing behavior. Missing for 10: explicit sharing/ACL permission model between agents, documented team/group memory concept, and independent hands-on confirmation of private-vs-shared memory isolation.
